source_trace: For each nonempty tier/species batch, grass_tuft_mesh uses configured native_blades_per_tuft_side as grid_side and enumerates 0..grid_side * grid_side before collecting blades; validation currently requires only a nonzero side.

Ribbon mesh buffer capacities depend on blade count and configured ribbon_rows length: ordinary blades use 2 * rows + 1 vertices and 2 * rows - 1 triangles. Vertex bases and offsets are cast to u32; near-tier seed heads append extra quads and crossed spikelets depending on species and deterministic selection.

The per-tier configured tuft footprint divides patch spacing by its tuft-side count, including near-edge, even though near-edge placements are copied from near. Safe admission must preserve that crossfade relationship while accounting for composed placement, mesh, allocation and device limits; no particular native failure is asserted.
